import polars as pl
import thinkthen as tt

# build a question once. The band's middle is null,
# "not sure": true, false, and null for the send-back line
refund = tt.question(decide="Does the customer ask for a refund?",
    threshold=(0.2, 0.8))
df = pl.DataFrame({"body": [
    "Please refund my order. It arrived broken.",
    "Thanks for the quick help yesterday!",
    "I want to send this back."]})
print(df.with_columns(refund=tt.decide(refund, df["body"])))
